tool_args.rationale: The narrow s_grad pilot does not identify the coupled siphon parameters reliably, and the task guidance specifies the open-branch probe to add wide s_grad leverage. The forecast horizon is only 0.6, so a slow-horizon probe is not indicated.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the standard siphon model to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot s_grad span is only 0.018, leaving vmax and rho collinear and rho poorly identified.
The supplied guidance specifically calls for wide s_grad leverage; trajectory refinement is not the current identifiability bottleneck.
It is explicitly irrelevant and should not be purchased.
All pilot s_grad values are near 1, below the stated supercritical regime; no high-s_grad evidence motivates that model.
